title: C1011 - C1011
engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
symptoms: Fren Change warning in Gösterge Paneli
Parking Fren function is not available
stepByStepSolution: Complete any repair work, use Temel Ayarları (Basic Settings) Yapın:  to "End lining change mode"
technicalNotes:
The LED in the Parking Fren Switch and the Warning Lamp in the Gösterge Paneli will likely continue to flash, accompanied by Fault Code C1011, indicating that Fren pad replacement mode is active.
This flashing warning should cease after completing the repair work and executing the Temel Ayarları (Basic Settings) Yapın:  for "End lining change mode." It may also be necessary to cycle the Parking Fren switch ON and then OFF while depressing the Fren pedal
